summaries_hint: We cut a video with the best moments, blending into each other, and save it to your library, in the Recuerdos folder. It takes a few minutes; we'll let you know when it's ready.
summaries_include_photos_hint: Photos show for a few seconds with a slow zoom between the videos.
summaries_music_hint: Cuts follow the beat, and the music dips by itself when someone talks.
summaries_music_invalid: That file won't do as music: use MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG or FLAC, at least 10 seconds and at most 50 MB.
summaries_music_missing: The music is no longer on the server. Choose it again.
summaries_no_years: You don't have any videos for a summary yet.
summaries_not_enough: There aren't enough videos for a summary.
summaries_not_enough_orientation: There aren't enough videos or photos in that orientation. Try “All”.
summaries_not_enough_photos: There aren't enough videos. Try including the photos.
summaries_orientation_all_hint: A landscape video; portrait material shows over a blurred background.
summaries_orientation_landscape_hint: Only landscape videos and photos, in a landscape video.
summaries_orientation_portrait_hint: Only portrait videos and photos, in a portrait video for phones.
summaries_queue_full: You already have several summary videos on the way. Wait for them to finish.
summaries_regenerate_hint: The previous video is replaced by a new one.
summaries_requested: Creating “{title}”. We'll let you know when it's ready.
summaries_titles_hint: An opening title and, at the start of each month or day, when and where.
